title: Route B: create user records with the Privilege console API
lede: The literal register-a-user call: POST /api/{tenant}/v1/users, one record per person, with the console's key and secret. Write-gated and UNVERIFIED against a real console. Simulated in Mock.

nodes.label: This lab (server)
sub: Holds the console secret (write-only). Same bounded pool and back-off as Route A.

steps.title: You press Plan
steps.what: Reads the people and the console's existing users. Writes nothing.

steps.title: List what the console already has
steps.what: One GET of the users collection. The swagger shows no paging parameters on it; whether the console pages is UNVERIFIED.

steps.title: Decide per person
steps.what: create, exists (already in the console), conflict or invalid. Re-running never creates a second record.

steps.title: You press Apply and type the count
steps.what: Same gate as Route A: the plan, the exact count, and in Real the writes switch.

steps.title: POST one record per new person
steps.what: A bounded pool of POST /v1/users calls. 429 backs off, 409 is read as already there, one failure never stops the run.
steps.why: UNVERIFIED: which ObjectMeta fields the real console requires on a user, and whether a user created this way can sign in. Route A is the path our own environment uses.

steps.title: Verify: plan again
steps.what: A second plan should find nothing left to create.
